column1: # Cases from the Mozhi 2.0 scheme, one per line.
# The third column is a note and is ignored by the evaluator.
# Only the unambiguous parts of the scheme are listed. The letters that carry
# no diacritics and differ only in case are left out, because the corpus
# writes them in lower case most of the time and the model is allowed to
# prefer the reading the context supports.
# The ശ, ഷ and സ case is also left out on purpose. Mozhi writes ശ as S and ഷ
# as sh, but the training corpus writes both as sh, which is what people
# actually type. The model is judged on the corpus convention.
